title: Team Apex Gaming BGMI Roster: Omega Talks After CEGC 2026
description: Team Apex Gaming BGMI roster talks reportedly involve Omega's line-up after CEGC 2026, while Team Jelly is said to leave. Here is what is confirmed.

body.text: The Team Apex Gaming BGMI roster may soon look very different. According to TalkEsport, which cites Indian esports insiders from 14 November, Jonathan's organisation is in final talks to sign a new BGMI line-up, and the Chennai Esports Global Championship (CEGC) 2026 is expected to be the current squad's last event. TAG has not commented and nothing is official. It matters because a new roster would be the organisation's biggest BGMI move since its launch.
What the Team Apex Gaming BGMI roster reports say

The first report says an official announcement will follow once CEGC 2026 ends. A second report, citing sources, went further and named names. It said TAG was in advanced talks with the line-up led by in-game leader (IGL) Omega, that the talks were going well, and that Omega had not yet given his final confirmation.

The same report said offers also went to other line-ups, including Saumraj's, and that a roster built around Punkk was seen as a last-resort option. It also claimed the exit of TAG's current squad, known as Team Jelly after its IGL, was confirmed for after CEGC 2026. TalkEsport says it has not independently verified any of these talks, and none of the players or teams named has responded.

The reports land just days after TAG co-founder Shreeman Legend played down disbandment rumours on stream on 12 November. He said the players were signed for one year and that he had heard nothing directly pointing to a change. He also said TAG would play CEGC 2026 with the same line-up, which the new reports do not contradict. Neither TAG nor Shreeman has explained how a new signing would fit with that one-year deal.
Where the players stand at CEGC 2026

items: Omega captains Team Outrage, which topped Group Stage 1 with 278 points and went straight to the Upper Bracket. His main four also includes slug, knightū and ninjaboi.
Saumraj leads K9 Esports and Punkk captains VR1 Esports. Both teams finished outside the top eight.
TAG is led by IGL Jellly, with Jonathan, Hydrooo and Harsh05 in the main four and KioLmao as a substitute. The team placed 15th in Group Stage 1 with 194 points, so it entered Group Stage 2.

body.text: Group Stage 2 runs until 16 November, and only the top eight teams move to the Upper Bracket. The rest drop to the Lower Bracket. Partway through, TAG was sitting close to that cut-off line.
CEGC 2026 timeline: when could an announcement land?

The current squad's run could last weeks. The Lower Bracket is played on 21 and 22 November, followed by a Last Chance Qualifier from 27 to 29 November. The 16-team Grand Finals are a LAN in Chennai from 11 to 13 December, with a ₹75 lakh prize pool. If TAG reaches the finals and waits for the event to end, a new roster might not be confirmed until mid-December.

Jonathan left GodLike Esports in April and launched TAG that month, with Shreeman among the founding members. This month TAG has signed EA FC Mobile players DeMYSTeRIO and HaloZeus, plus grandmaster Vidit Gujrathi as its first chess player. It also fields a team in the PUBG India Challenge 2026. Jonathan, whose YouTube channel has over 8 million subscribers, still plays in the BGMI squad as an assaulter. The roster talk also comes amid his public dispute with GodLike owner Chetan "Kronten" Chandgude, whose early-November claims Jonathan called "completely wrong" on 12 November.

What to watch next: Team Jelly plays its final Group Stage 2 matches on 16 November, and that result decides whether it reaches the Upper Bracket. After that, look for any word from TAG, Omega or Shreeman on the one-year deal, and whether the Omega talks become official once CEGC 2026 wraps up.

faqs.q: Is Team Apex Gaming getting a new BGMI roster?
faqs.a: According to TalkEsport, citing Indian esports insiders, TAG is in final talks for a new BGMI roster, with an announcement expected after CEGC 2026. TAG has not commented, so it remains a report and not an official confirmation.

faqs.q: Which BGMI players are linked with Team Apex Gaming?
faqs.a: One report named the line-up led by IGL Omega as being in advanced talks, though Omega had not given his final confirmation. Offers also reportedly went to other line-ups, including Saumraj's, with a roster built around Punkk described as a last resort.

faqs.q: When is the CEGC 2026 Grand Finals?
faqs.a: The 16-team Grand Finals take place at a LAN in Chennai from 11 to 13 December. The tournament has a prize pool of ₹75 lakh.
